summary.text: Joseph Trost is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 52 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a construction worker from LaGrange County who lists Right to Repair, childcare costs and limits on license-plate-reader surveillance among his priorities.

paragraphs.text: Joseph Trost graduated from Lakeland High School, and Ballotpedia lists his profession as construction worker.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was raised in LaGrange County as the son of a public school teacher and an Army master sergeant, earned a bachelor's degree in political science with a minor in history from IU Indianapolis, and spent eight years as a concrete form setter for foundation walls in the housing industry.

Trost said his key messages include supporting Right to Repair laws, eliminating sales tax on used car purchases, expanding childcare assistance eligibility, and limiting automated license plate readers.
He also said he wants to end the state's school voucher system and increase education investment.
